title: Spectral Ruleset
description: A Spectral ruleset: a portable, machine-readable set of API governance rules applied to JSON or YAML documents. This schema describes the serialized (JSON/YAML) form of the format. See https://github.com/api-commons/spotlight-spec for the specification.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this ruleset governs.

documentationUrl.description: URL to documentation for this ruleset. Used as the fallback documentation link for any rule that does not declare its own.

formats.description: Document formats this ruleset applies to. Acts as the default for every rule that does not declare its own formats. When omitted, rules apply to every document.

extends.description: Other rulesets this ruleset inherits from.

rules.description: Map of rule name to rule definition. A rule name is the stable identifier reported in results and used to override the rule downstream.

aliases.description: Named, reusable path expressions that rules may reference from `given` with a leading `#`.

overrides.description: Per-file and per-location adjustments applied on top of the ruleset.

parserOptions.description: Severities for problems detected while parsing the document itself, before any rule runs.

functions.description: Names of custom functions to load from `functionsDir`. Serialized rulesets only; JavaScript rulesets import functions directly instead.

functionsDir.description: Directory, relative to the ruleset file, that custom functions named in `functions` are loaded from. Defaults to `functions`.

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: How a rule's results are reported. `off` (-1) disables the rule. Defaults to `warn` when unset.

format.title: Format
format.description: Identifier of a document format. A format is a predicate that decides whether a given document is of that kind, so a rule scoped to a format only runs against matching documents. The listed values are those registered by the reference implementation; any string is permitted so that new and custom formats remain valid.

pathExpression.title: Path expression
pathExpression.description: Either a JSONPath expression beginning with `$`, or an alias reference beginning with `#` optionally followed by a JSONPath subset (for example `#Info.description`).

given.title: Given
given.description: The part or parts of the document a rule is applied to. A single path expression, or an array of them.

functionInvocation.title: Function invocation
functionInvocation.description: The assertion half of a rule: the function to run against each node matched by `given`, and the options it takes.

field.description: Narrow the assertion to a single property of the matched node, rather than the node itself. `@key` targets the node's own key.

function.description: Name of a core function (`alphabetical`, `casing`, `defined`, `enumeration`, `falsy`, `length`, `pattern`, `schema`, `truthy`, `undefined`, `unreferencedReusableObject`, `xor`, `or`) or of a custom function declared in `functions`.

functionOptions.description: Options passed to the function. The accepted shape is defined by the function itself.

then.title: Then
then.description: One assertion, or an array of assertions all applied to the nodes matched by `given`.

ruleDefinition.title: Rule definition
ruleDefinition.description: A complete rule: where to look (`given`) and what must hold there (`then`).

description.description: Human-readable statement of what the rule requires.

documentationUrl.description: URL explaining the rule and how to satisfy it. Reported alongside results.

message.description: Template for the reported message. Supports the placeholders `{{error}}`, `{{description}}`, `{{path}}`, `{{property}}`, and `{{value}}`.

severity.description: Severity of this rule's results. Defaults to `warn`.

formats.description: Document formats this rule applies to. Overrides the ruleset-level `formats`.

recommended.description: Whether the rule is enabled when a consumer extends this ruleset in `recommended` mode. Defaults to true.

resolved.description: Whether the rule runs against the document with `$ref`s resolved (true, the default) or against the raw authored document (false). Set to false for rules about references themselves.

tags.description: Free-form labels for grouping and filtering rules.

type.description: Coarse classification of the rule. `validation` rules assert correctness; `style` rules assert convention.

extensions.description: Arbitrary consumer-defined metadata carried with the rule and ignored by the engine.

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: A full rule definition, or — when adjusting a rule inherited via `extends` — a severity string, or a boolean where false disables the rule and true restores its declared severity.

extendsEntry.title: Extends entry
extendsEntry.description: A reference to another ruleset: a built-in (`spectral:oas`, `spectral:asyncapi`, `spectral:arazzo`), a file path, an npm module, or a URL.

extendsTuple.title: Scoped extends entry
extendsTuple.description: A ruleset reference paired with the set of its rules to enable: `recommended` (the default), `all`, or `off`.

aliasTarget.title: Alias target
aliasTarget.description: The path expressions an alias resolves to for one set of formats.

scopedAlias.title: Scoped alias
scopedAlias.description: An alias that resolves to different path expressions depending on the format of the document being linted.

alias.title: Alias
alias.description: Either a list of path expressions, or a scoped alias that varies by format.

duplicateKeys.description: Severity for duplicate keys found in the document. Defaults to `error`.

incompatibleValues.description: Severity for YAML values that cannot be represented in JSON. Defaults to `error`.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: Ordered list of adjustments. Later matching entries win over earlier ones, and every override wins over the base ruleset.

override.title: Override
override.description: An adjustment scoped by `files`. When every glob in `files` carries a JSON Pointer fragment (`path/to/file.yaml#/paths/~1users`), the override may only change rule severities. Otherwise it may change anything a ruleset can declare.
